In addition to being able to play the sport he loves, he also does it to become romantically involved with a lovely player.  The film also stars Vivica A. Fox, Kevin Pollak, Tommy Davidson, Kim Wayans, Ginuwine, and J. Don Ferguson.  The movie is written by Bradley Allenstein and produced by Bill Gerber.  The movie opened in theaters on June 21, 2002. The movie's soundtrack features music by Diana Ross, James Brown, Mystikal, Ginuwine, and Stevie Wonder.
Charlotte Coleman | Charlotte Ninon Coleman (3 April 1968 – 14 November 2001) was an English actress best known for playing Scarlett in the film "Four Weddings and a Funeral", Jess in the television drama "Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit", and her childhood roles of Sue in "Worzel Gummidge" and the character Marmalade Atkins.
